subheader: One plan, one card, one button
lead: Each plan is its own content element. You can reorder, hide or translate one plan without touching the others.
note: The note holds the conditions of the price, such as tax, term or minimum quantity.

features.title: Rows that say what is included
features.text: Each mark has a text label, so a screen reader announces it too.

features.title: A value at the end of a row
features.text: For a quantity or a limit, such as storage or seats.

features.title: A note under a row
features.text: For a condition that applies to that row only.

features.title: Buttons at the foot of the card
features.text: Full width, so each label fits on a phone.

features.title: Excluded rows stay in the list
features.text: Removing them would hide how this plan differs from the next.

features.title: Totals worked out for you
features.text: The card shows the price as written and adds nothing up.
